title: Web Design Execution Path
purpose: Help users learn web design by building visible, useful web artifacts immediately.
core_output: A real website, landing page, portfolio, dashboard, or product page.

30_second_start: Open one HTML file or design canvas.
Pick one inspiration site and screenshot it.
3_minute_start: Create a single hero section with a headline and button.
Make one profile card with name, photo placeholder, and short bio.
Copy the layout of one favorite card and rebuild it roughly.
10_minute_build: Build a homepage wireframe with header, hero, feature cards, and footer.
Create a dashboard card with title, metric, and short explanation.
Turn a boring assignment into a clean one-page study dashboard.

phases.name: Visible First Win
phases.objective: Create something visual immediately so the user feels progress.
phases.checkpoint: User has one visible component on screen.

phases.name: Layout Control
phases.objective: Learn spacing, alignment, grids, and sections through a real page.
phases.checkpoint: User can explain why each section is placed where it is.

phases.name: Style System
phases.objective: Create a reusable style language with colors, typography, buttons, and cards.
phases.checkpoint: User has reusable styles instead of one-off random design choices.

phases.name: Responsive + Accessible
phases.objective: Make the design work on phone, tablet, and desktop with readable structure.
phases.checkpoint: User checks mobile width and improves readability/accessibility.

phases.name: Deploy + Share
phases.objective: Publish the work so the user gets a real-world reward loop.
phases.checkpoint: User has a live URL or shareable artifact.

modalities.visual: Use screenshots, layout maps, and before/after comparisons.
modalities.audio: Have the user describe the page out loud before editing.
modalities.walking: Walk for 3 minutes and decide the page's one main purpose.
modalities.music_supported: Use a 10-minute playlist sprint to style one section.
modalities.reading: Read one tiny concept, then apply it immediately.

adaptive_rules.action: Use 30-second or 3-minute starts only. Avoid full-page tasks.
Offer a 20-minute build sprint with a required stopping checkpoint.
Convert project into one component only: card, button, hero, or navbar.
Inject novelty: redesign favorite app, movie page, game UI, or dashboard.

outside_app_uses: Generate a static HTML file plan.
Create a checklist for VS Code or Codex.
Turn an assignment into a visual webpage project.
